Villa Laubach on Airbnb ↗
BEFORE YOU TRAVEL

A few things to know.

Is the entire building exclusive to guests?+

The guest accommodation is a self-contained unit. The same building contains a separate loft for the host, who may sometimes stay there. Please ask the host about the use of outdoor areas.

How many guests can stay?+

The accommodation is listed for up to eight guests with four bedrooms. Confirm bed arrangements and children’s needs with the host.

What are the check-in and check-out times?+

Please follow the terms of your specific booking and confirm any particular arrival needs directly with the host.

Is the house step-free?+

There are stairs in the house. Please discuss mobility needs and individual requirements with the host before booking.

Where is Villa Laubach?+

Hohlweg 2, 56759 Laubach, Rhineland-Palatinate. This is Laubach in the Eifel. Check your route using the full address before travelling.
